$comment: Hand-edited: the published versions of each legal document (agent/plans/PLAN-terms-acceptance.md Design 2).
Per document: `page` (the www slug), `catalogKey` (the key under `pages.` of en.json) and `versions`, oldest first.

A version is {version, effective, material, sha256}; both dates are UTC YYYY-MM-DD and increase. A typo fix is a new version with material false; a material change is a new version effective at least 30 days later.

Declare a version without `sha256`: `npx tsx scripts/gen/gen-legal.ts --write` archives its canonical text under packages/www/public/legal/archive/ and fills the hash. An archive is immutable, and check:ci-terms-version holds the text, this file, the archives and the generated modules in step.
